name: Beam Radiance Estimate
aliases: Volumetric Photon Mapping with Beam Estimate
Volumetric Photon Mapping with Ray Query
definition: A photon gathering technique that replaces the ray marching computation of conventional photon mapping by querying all photons along a ray (line) rather than sampling points along the ray, using a smoothing kernel with local support.
summary: Beam Radiance Estimate is a photon-based technique that estimates in-scattered radiance by blurring photons into discs perpendicular to the camera ray, reducing noise and redundancy compared to conventional spherical methods.
